transcript.content:
I've identified the issue. The warning at line 2224 in `tokenization_utils_base.py` incorrectly says "`max_length` is ignored when `padding`=`True`" even when `truncation=True` is also specified. In that case, `max_length` is actually used for truncation, so the warning is misleading. The fix is to only show the warning when truncation is not also active.

The file that needs to be modified is:

- `src/transformers/tokenization_utils_base.py`

The fix is on line 2224: change `if max_length is not None:` to `if max_length is not None and truncation is False:` (or equivalently `if max_length is not None and not truncation:`), so the warning is only raised when truncation is disabled — the only scenario where `max_length` is truly ignored.
